_source: Verified against the individual course pages at lcbt.co.uk on 7 Sept 2026. Every live course's blurb, duration, start date, entry requirements and funding is quoted from its own course page. Start dates go stale - the year-long courses read September 2027 and the Level 4 reads September 2026. explore-l2 / explore-l3 are marked unavailable: client feedback (9 Sept 2026) was that 'see all courses' should not be a swipeable card. Kept rather than deleted because the client flagged the fallback design as unfinished - flip available and re-add to matching.json to bring them back.

l2-beauty.title: Level 2 Diploma in Beauty Therapy
l2-beauty.blurb: Learn the practical skills you need to begin a career in beauty therapy. Train in facials, waxing, manicures, pedicures and lash treatments, before progressing to Level 3 to become a fully qualified beauty therapist.
l2-beauty.entryRequirements: Recommended Grade 3+ in GCSE English and Maths

l2-mua.title: Level 2 Diploma in Hair & Media Make-Up
l2-mua.blurb: Learn the creative skills you need for a hair styling or make-up career in the world of film, TV and theatre. You'll explore make-up application and hairdressing styles for different occasions, plus self-tanning and lash application.
l2-mua.entryRequirements: Recommended minimum Grade 3 in GCSE English & Maths

l2-hair.title: Level 2 Diploma in Hairdressing
l2-hair.blurb: Develop the practical skills you need to start a career in hairdressing. You'll learn the essentials of cutting, colouring, styling and caring for all different hair types, with the opportunity to progress to Level 3.
l2-hair.entryRequirements: Recommended minimum Grade 3 in GCSE English & Maths

l3-beauty.title: Level 3 Diploma in Beauty Therapy
l3-beauty.blurb: Develop the professional skills you need to become a fully qualified beauty therapist. You'll learn complex treatments such as massage, body and facial electrical treatments and epilation.

l3-mua.title: Level 3 Diploma in Hair & Media Make-Up
l3-mua.blurb: Build the advanced creative skills you need to become a professional stylist or make-up artist. You'll learn fashion and photographic make-up, creative hairdressing and special effects make-up.
l3-mua.entryRequirements: Level 2 qualification in Hair & Media Make-up or Beauty Therapy

l3-hair.title: Level 3 Diploma in Hairdressing
l3-hair.blurb: Learn the professional skills you need to become a fully qualified hair stylist. You'll learn advanced cutting, styling and colouring techniques and gain the confidence to enter the industry as a qualified stylist or colour technician.

l4-aesthetic.title: 19+ CIBTAC Level 4 Diploma in Aesthetic Practice
l4-aesthetic.blurb: Ideal for those already working as beauty therapists or in related sectors who want to increase their skills, services and earning potential. Teaches a range of popular advanced clinical techniques.

short-courses.title: Short Courses
short-courses.blurb: Bite-sized, single-subject courses to build a specific skill fast.

explore-l2.title: Explore all Level 2 courses
explore-l2.blurb: Not sure which one? Browse every Level 2 course we run and see what jumps out.
explore-l2.entryRequirements: Recommended minimum Grade 3 in GCSE English & Maths

explore-l3.title: Explore all Level 3 courses
explore-l3.blurb: Browse every Level 3 course. Entry requirements vary, so check each one against the Level 2 you hold.
explore-l3.entryRequirements: A relevant Level 2 qualification — varies by course
explore-l3.funding: Fully funded for 16-18; fees apply for 19+ (loans available)

register-interest.title: We're always adding new courses
register-interest.blurb: We don't have a match for this yet, but register your interest and we'll let you know the moment something opens up.
